ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯~~！面试结束了~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （我在初中的时候担任过学生会会长，成绩品行也不差）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（虽然转学的时间很奇怪，
但入学应该没问题吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （私立羽丘女子学园，高中部……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……在这里，我要重新开始

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（那个女孩……怎么了？
蹲在那种地方……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……哎，你弄丢了什么吗？
我和你一起找吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……咦？她没听见？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （她在找什么……嗯？在捡石头？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （她把石头装进口袋了……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 呃……你要把那块石头带回家吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你总算注意到我了。
我一直在跟你打招呼……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
初次见面！
从今天起，我就是班上的一员了，我叫千早爱音！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
虽然由于家庭的原因，我入学的时间有点奇怪，
不过还是希望能和大家好好相处。
请大家多多关照！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（呼——虽然自我介绍说的全是套话，
但要融入班级，这种程度应该就行了吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，石头……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊、啊哈哈哈，请多关照啦——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（我的座位在这女孩后面啊……
我记得，她就是转学面试当天遇到的那个捡石头的女孩吧？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……诶，怎么了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯、嗯……请多关照

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（糟糕，已经到午休时间了……！
该和谁拉近关系比较好呢~）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（那个女生，太兴奋了……
那边的女生……又太正经了）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（这女孩有点……太特别了？
那边的三人组……嗯，感觉比较好搭话）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个……我可以
和你们一起吃便当吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
真的吗？太好了~
我还在想，要是找不到一起吃饭的人
该怎么办呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……叫我爱音就好！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_30
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——是呢——真的很辛苦！
大家都已经有自己的小圈子了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_31
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不不！
前几天她在捡石头？的时候，我正好碰见了她……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_32
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯？哇！这是什么！
为什么会有羽毛掉在桌子上……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_33
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶，这个……是高松同学的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_34
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（为什么包里会有鸟的羽毛……！？
而且还有好多根……！？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_35
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（本来觉得她是个奇怪的人……
难道说，那女孩意外地受欢迎……？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_36
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（与其说是班宠……
更像是班里的吉祥物吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_38
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我刚刚注意到，
这个班里，带乐器的人很多啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_39
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小舞你们也带着乐器呢，
是在玩乐队吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_40
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶……大家都在玩乐队啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_41
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？啊~有一点。
姑且算是吉他手兼主唱吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_42
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （吉他？以吉他手的身份加入这三人组……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_43
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （也就是……我站角落啊……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_44
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢谢你们邀请我~！
不过，自从初中的文化节以后，我就没碰过吉他了，
弹得不太好，不好意思加入……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_45
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 乐队我有点想组组看，我会自己找找成员的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_46
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是、是吗——RiNG啊——
谢谢你们告诉我——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_47
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 在LIVEHOUSE寻找成员啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_48
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我也没打算那么认真地玩乐队，
要是能在学校里找到成员就好了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_49
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……这个钢琴声……
是从音乐室传来的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_50
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（弹钢琴的，是那个女生……！
应该不是……社团活动吧，只有她一个人）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_51
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （话说，她弹得真好……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_52
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你钢琴弹得真好啊……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_53
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，不是！
我就是单纯过来听听……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_54
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那个……你要不要和我组乐队？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_55
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……不好意思，我说得没头没尾的。
唔，我是1年级A班的千早

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_56
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，叫我爱音就好。
我正在寻找乐队成员，我是吉他手兼主唱……
想说你愿不愿意来当键盘手——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_57
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……不行吗……
还以为好不容易找到了厉害的键盘手呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_58
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 有没有愿意和我组乐队的人呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_59
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯？那边的是……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_60
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （我记得她也没有组乐队吧？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_61
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
喂——！那个，我记得是叫……
高松同学——呀啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_62
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好痛……
绊了一跤……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_63
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，没事没事~
只是手掌有点擦伤而已……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_64
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……诶？
等、等等……你要去哪里！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_65
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，找到了找到了。
你突然跑走了，真是吓我一跳——
怎么了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_66
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？好厉害，这些全都是创可贴！？
一整个糖果盒里都是创可贴嘛

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_67
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶——真是不好意思——
每个图案都很可爱呢~
啊，我喜欢这个企鹅图案的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_68
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？帽带？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_69
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 高、高松同学也喜欢企鹅吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_70
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——不过我好像能懂你的想法。
我也会觉得笔很可爱，然后买了一堆用不到的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_71
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 等、等下等下，不用拿这么多

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_72
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……我、我知道了，我收下！
不要一下子就失落啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_73
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唉……高松同学是天文社的吗？
这里有望远镜，应该是天文社的活动室吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_74
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯？那个是乐队的海报吧。
好像是叫……Roselia？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_75
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你说的笔记本，是指这本活动日志吗？
我看看……今天看了星星。星空好噜♪啊……
噜是什么……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_76
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……天文社好像很容易吸引神奇的人，
或者说是有个性的人呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_77
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？啊~~嗯，我会考虑的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_78
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
真是的——又开始失落了——
不要动不动就失落嘛……嗯？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_79
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这本笔记本是高松同学的吗？
原来高松同学也写日志啊，我能看看吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_80
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 高松同学这不是有在玩乐队嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_81
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这里写的是歌词吧？
也写着和弦呢……啊！
还贴着乐队乐谱的复印件！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_82
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶——这首歌叫『春日影』啊。
我没听过呢，是哪一支乐队的歌？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_83
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
真的吗？那要和我组乐队吗？
我是吉他手兼主唱，
除此之外你担任什么都可以哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_84
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（如果班级里的吉祥物加入，
肯定会引人注目的）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_85
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……啊，是吗——
抱歉抱歉。你不感兴趣的话没关系的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_87
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——真是的——！不行！
这种阴沉的气氛，我真的不擅长啦——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_88
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不用道歉，快收拾一下！
我们去卡拉OK吧，小灯！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_89
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
心情不好的时候，最好的办法就是出去玩！
我陪你去，好了，走吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_90
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
从刚才开始你就一直在发呆，怎么了？
难道说你是第一次来卡拉OK？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_91
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是吗。那你会唱sumimi的歌吗？
我唱初华的部分，你唱真奈的部分

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_92
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，你不知道sumimi吗？
最近还挺火的啊……
是双人组合，很可爱~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_93
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——你不知道啊……
那还是唱你喜欢的歌吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_94
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不擅长也没关系哦！
难得我们一起来，只有我一个人唱多不好啊？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_95
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……那么，刚才那首叫什么来着？
『春日影』……唔——搜不出来呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_96
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，是原创歌曲吗……？
难道说，小灯的乐队是挺专业的那种……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_97
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那个……你说会再次失败，是指什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_98
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就算组乐队也会再次失败，是为什么？
你以前的乐队经常发生争执吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_99
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……难道是那个吗？
音乐理念的差异！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_100
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……是吗。
那你一定很难受吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_101
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……不过，只要努力不再失败，不就好了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_102
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就算失败一次，也要有重新再来的勇气啊——
否则，人生那么长，肯定会很难熬哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_103
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这次说不定能奇迹般地
遇到非常棒的成员呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_104
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——那个人倒不一定是我。
不过，我还是希望你能来组乐队嘛~♪
毕竟小灯有经验

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_105
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……诶？一辈子？
啊……啊哈哈，小灯真会说笑呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_106
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊！小灯！？
你要去哪里！？等一下……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_107
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯！等等！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_108
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哈啊、哈啊……
抱歉，突然笑你……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_110
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
什、什么……
这个人是谁？是小灯认识的人吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_111
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，啊！小灯！？
又逃跑了……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_112
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 都说了，我是小灯的朋友——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_113
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
她逃跑了，我才追她的！
我只是邀请她组乐队而已

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_114
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是啊？
我说啊，不要总是你这家伙你这家伙的——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_115
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
！？哈啊！？
胡搅蛮缠的明明是你吧！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_116
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等！……那家伙怎么回事啊！！
也太没礼貌了吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_117
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 怎么可能没事……呃，诶？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_118
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，唔……没、没事~
什么事都没有，别担心~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_119
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （唔——怒吼的样子被人看见，好尴尬啊……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_120
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 早~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_121
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （唔，小灯很低落……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_122
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（从昨天的情况来看，也不是没有道理……
小灯的乐队，好像发生了很多事情）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_123
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（一辈子……这种事，我还是不太明白……
但越想越不是滋味……好）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_124
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……早~小灯

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_125
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，你又在看企鹅创可贴吗？
这是什么种类的企鹅来着？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_126
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对对，是帽带企鹅！
你在活动室给我的创可贴上也有它呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_127
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那我就收下啦。谢谢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_128
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （唔……看这个感觉，应该没问题吧~）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_129
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （这么说来，她们好像是说过这件事……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_130
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊~还没有呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_131
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （其实我也没那么认真啦……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_132
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （不过，这种话也说不出口啊……唉……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_133
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢谢你们三个~！
那既然有这个机会，就拜托啦——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_134
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（我就觉得好像在哪里见过
RiNG这个名字……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_135
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（昨天被那个怪人纠缠的地方
就是RiNG的门口嘛）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_136
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（难道说，那家伙是这里的工作人员？
呃，要是再碰到就太糟糕了）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_137
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（小舞她们已经去录音棚练习了，
看完公告板上的招募信息我就走人吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_138
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔，公告板公告板……
招募鼓手，招募键盘手和贝斯手……嗯？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_139
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊！是昨天那个月之森的人！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_140
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （提到月之森，那可是名门中的名门贵族女校……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_141
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（听说只有政治家和艺人的孩子才能入学，
如果能和她交朋友，说不定会有好事发生……！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_142
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢谢你担心我，跟我搭话。
而我连句谢谢都没说就走了，真是抱歉

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_143
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那时候我被不认识的女孩缠上了，正头疼呢——
她一直大声说着我听不懂的话，真是的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_144
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（糟、糟糕……！
这个人和昨天那家伙居然认识吗……！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_145
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呃，那个……
说了你朋友的坏话，对不起……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_146
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那吉他手是怎么回事……好厉害！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_147
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这、这样啊……
话说，这边的咖啡厅真厉害呢。
甚至还有能演奏的舞台

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_148
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？你上高一吗？
因为看起来很稳重，我还以为你是学姐呢~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_149
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个，可以问一下你的名字吗？
我叫爱音！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_150
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哦哦……是的，
但完全没有适合我的位置……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_151
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，社交平台……还有这种东西啊。
爽世同学，你很了解乐队相关的事呢！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_152
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？月之森的人组乐队……？
有点惊讶……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_153
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
真好啊~！
我们高中的人，大家都在玩乐队呢~
但没有乐队有适合我的位置……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_154
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我是主唱和吉他手！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_155
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
实在不行的话，吉他的位置也可以让给别人……
不过，我还是想当主唱~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_157
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（这家伙，是昨天那个人……！
绝对不想见到的家伙出现了……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_158
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 真好~！我也要一样的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_159
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 她啧了一声！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_160
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 什么啊……！态度好差~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_161
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不知道。
我和朋友说着话，她就突然冒出来了，
问我找她有什么事~真的和她是朋友吗~之类的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_162
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还问我是不是邀请灯加入乐队，然后突然就发火了……
真是莫名其妙~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_163
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？啊，是的……
我们是同班同学……你们认识吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_164
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……
虽然我是邀请了她，但被她拒绝了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_165
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
说起来，爽世同学。
你在乐队里负责哪个位置呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_166
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶~！你贝斯
弹得怎么样？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_167
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊~那么！
我想给爽世同学一个提议……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_168
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（她有乐队经验，
懂得很多，看起来很可靠……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_169
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（而且，乐器的实力好像和我差不多！
就乐队位置来说，我的位置更显眼……！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_170
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学……
要不要和我一起组乐队？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_171
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？真的吗！？
你真的愿意和我组乐队吗……！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_172
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，完全没问题！
可以告诉我你的联系方式吗！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_173
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （太好了~~~~！！爽世同学LOVE！！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_174
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是爽世同学叫我来的~
说是想聊一聊乐队的事

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_175
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……啊，爽世同学来了！
爽世同学~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_176
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 没事！我根本没有等！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_177
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……诶？
今天是要聊乐队的事……对吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_178
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我是主唱和吉他手哦！
主唱兼吉他！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_179
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶！？
爽世同学……你在说什么！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_180
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学！
我们不需要这个人！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_182
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（诶……？她们在说什么？
又是小灯怎么样，又是受伤的……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_183
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（……嗯？等一下……
小灯说的之前失败的那个乐队，该不会……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_184
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学，难道说……
你以前加入的乐队……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_185
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不，没有……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_186
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……是一支什么样的乐队呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_187
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 手机视频……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_188
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……太好了，小灯来了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_189
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对不起哦，突然把你叫出来。
因为没提前打过招呼，吓到你了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_190
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……我听爽世同学说了哦。
CRYCHIC的事情

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_191
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯，原来你以前是主唱啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_192
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我看了你们乐队的演奏视频……
你唱歌的时候真的很开心

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_193
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小灯……
你其实是想要组乐队的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_194
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……因为，春日影是一首好歌。
该说是触动到我了吗……
我说不好，就是有点惊讶

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_195
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我能感受到，小灯组乐队时快乐的心情。
对你来说，乐队真的很重要吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_196
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……爽世同学，
小灯回去了……没关系吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_197
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你们这么长时间都没有说过话啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_198
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小祥？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_199
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？那个女生，在我们学校……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_200
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯、嗯……
上次我看见她在音乐室里弹钢琴……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_202
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……小灯说，乐队解散
是她的错吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_203
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: CRYCHIC到底发生了什么事……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_204
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （小灯从早上开始就没什么精神呢……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_205
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （她好像一直无法忘记乐队的事情……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_206
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （稍微去看看她的情况吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_207
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小灯，关于昨天的事情——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_208
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等、等等。
也不用那么惊讶吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_209
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 话说，你刚才是不是把笔记本藏在身后了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_210
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 笔记本掉下来了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_211
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我帮你捡起来……嗯？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_212
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （这是……小灯组乐队时的笔记本？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_213
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （这个歌词，是前些天看到的『春日影』的……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_214
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小灯……
如果你有什么心事，还是说出来比较好哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_215
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好了，你也快点过来！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_216
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谁叫不解决这个问题
小灯就没办法组乐队嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_217
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好。都到齐了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_218
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 来，谈谈吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_219
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
乐队的事情！
你们都没有把想说的话说出来吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_220
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
为什么会这么想？
春日影那首歌，不是超棒的吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_221
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那个……我呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_222
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
刚才说的重组乐队……
『大家』里面，好像不包含我

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_223
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 对哦，你以前说过……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_224
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等等等，等一下！
那可是一辈子哦！？一辈子！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_225
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
大家知道平均寿命吗？
据说，等我们老了的时候，
人类的平均寿命大概是90岁哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_226
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
人生也不知道会发生什么……
你变成了老奶奶也要敲鼓吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_227
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……啊——嗯——
一辈子……一辈子……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_228
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……我、我知道了，好吧！
总之，短期目标……先定个一周怎么样？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_229
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……一个月！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_230
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……那就到第一次演出之前！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_231
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我还不知道能不能一辈子组乐队，
先从演出开始吧！
大家一起！好不好！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_232
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唉……说得好沉重……
啊，没有没有！我会加油的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_233
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是的！我们先好好讨论一下
乐队的整体方针和形象之类的吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_234
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
虽然有很多事情要决定，
但最先要决定的还是各自负责的乐器吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_235
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我很擅长做这种事——
以前还当过学生会会长！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_236
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（能组成乐队真是幸运♪
……虽然我满脑子想的都是这个，
但现在不是兴奋的时候吧）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_237
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（小灯以前是主唱，
不能让她和我的吉他兼主唱冲突……！
中间的位置，我绝对不能让出去！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_238
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……小灯，你会敲铃鼓吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_239
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我想了很多适合小灯的乐器哦——
小灯在舞台上敲铃鼓应该会很可爱！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_240
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，还有三角铁和响板也不错吧？
小灯，你可以选一个自己喜欢的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_241
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 和声？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_242
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……！
是乐队名吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_243
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯嗯，这个也很重要呢~
其实，我想了很多~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_244
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那个……比方说，『Unknown』？
『哎嘤。』？还有『爱红薯』之类的~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_245
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是啊？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_246
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？你怎么一直在说任性的话啊……
那就把你的名字也加进去吧。
『TAKI』要怎么写？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_247
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶——『立』和『希』啊……
那不就是『Rikki』嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_248
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
像兔子一样！
啊~但乐队名叫『兔希』可不行

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_249
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，真的。已经这个时间了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_250
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
因为Rikki一直在抱怨吧？
小灯都说会努力敲铃鼓了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_251
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对吧，小灯！
下次乐队会议，好好定下我们负责的部分吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_252
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_253
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……！
嗯……不客气！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_254
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
怎么样？刚才的C和弦！
我觉得还挺不错的~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_255
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
什么都会哦！
G和弦，Am和弦，啊，还有F和弦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_256
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哎、哎呀——我们参加演出是不是还太早了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_257
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 但是，我们都还没有练习呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_258
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但、但是歌曲呢？
我们连一首能演奏的歌曲都没有哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_259
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不是，等一下。
那首歌我只听过一次啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_260
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……等等，为什么开始准备吉他了？
有谁叫她来练习吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_261
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （这女孩的吉他技术，好厉害……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_263
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 为什么！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_265
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那个！
我有点事，先回去了哦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_266
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 抱歉，我会再联系你们的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_267
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 糟糕、糟糕……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_268
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（那个叫乐奈的孩子……虽然性格很奇怪，
但吉他技术简直就像专业的一样……！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_269
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（然而……
我却说什么G和弦F和弦的，简直太丢人了！）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_270
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
（……话说，
她加入乐队的话……我不就变成空气了！？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_271
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊啊~~怎么办~~！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_272
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就算从现在开始练习，
也不可能立刻进步……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_273
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……嗯？手机有通知？
若麦麦的美妆视频更新了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_274
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哈啊~今天没办法再练了。
看看若麦麦的视频，把这些事都暂时忘掉吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_276
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 快速轻松……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_277
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……！就是这个……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_278
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯，要不要写新歌？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_279
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我觉得，新乐队果然需要新歌呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_280
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯，你在以前的乐队里参加过作曲吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_281
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
所以，我有个请求……
吉他部分，一开始能不能稍微简单一点呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_282
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你想啊，除了新歌以外，还有很多需要准备的吧？
要是能很快写出一首不错的曲子，我会很感激的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_283
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……对哦！
抱歉，我太冒失了……哈哈……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_284
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （呜……快速轻松地升级计划，失败了……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_285
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯？怎么了？
你好像没什么精神……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_286
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ？是很难说出口的话？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_287
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……！？
为什么……不对……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_288
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你是……认真的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_289
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你们想呀，我们没有乐队名，也没有演出服吧？
就这样演出的话应该不合适吧~
小灯也是这么说的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_290
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我刚才不是说了嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_291
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 所以说，小灯她——！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_292
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……结束……
是指像以前的乐队一样……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_293
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好了，你想说什么……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_294
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不……
小灯不是说了不想演出嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_295
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
而且，就算要演出，这次是不是也太赶了？
还是做好准备，在万无一失的状态下举办演出吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_296
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这样的话，小灯肯定也能
更好地……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_298
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我……都说了——！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_300
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 什么……我才没有逃避

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_301
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我、我当然有练习！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_302
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ！！我没有逃避！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_303
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哈啊、哈啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_304
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嘴上说着没有逃避，但现在明明就在尽全力逃跑……
我果然还是在逃避吗……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_306
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不会吧，为什么……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_309
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （等等。别再问我了……）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_311
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那个，这个是……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_312
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小、小灯……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_313
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……！？
等等，小灯……！？
你要带我去哪里……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_314
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 为什么要来水族馆……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_316
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……难道说，
你是想安慰我？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_317
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你记得啊……
它们是什么企鹅来着。
你给我的创可贴里有吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_318
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……噗，这样啊……
说起来你好像是给过我……呵呵

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_319
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哈啊~谢、
谢谢……多亏了你，我心情好点了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_320
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……刚才，
Rikki在咖啡厅里说的话……
其实是对的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_321
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就是说我在逃避的那个。
我转学的时间不是很奇怪吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_322
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
自我介绍的时候我说是因为家里的原因……
但真正的原因是，我之前去海外留学了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_323
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但是，我完全跟不上那边的节奏，
然后就逃走了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_324
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我初中的时候很开心

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_325
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
每个学校里都会有个引人注目的、受欢迎的人吧？
在我们初中，我就是那样的人

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_326
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这种话自己说可能不太合适，
我当时成绩好，又是学生会会长，
交友的圈子也是学校里最闪闪发光的一群人

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_327
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我在文化节上参加乐队表演时，气氛很热烈，
学妹们都用崇拜的目光看着我

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_328
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我觉得，
自己就是这所学校的中心

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_329
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
可是，正因为太顺利了，
我才没有看清自己

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_330
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
因为英语好，我就一时兴起想去留学，
离开日本才发现，
留学生活和我想象中完全不同

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_331
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我本来以为，在英国也能像初中时那样，
成为学校的中心……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_332
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我本来以为自己很擅长的。
可却连自己想说的一半都表达不出来……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_333
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
而且，其他留学生都很有主见。
我连他们说的一半都听不懂，只能边听边笑

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_334
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还有，大家都很优秀。
都是有自己的理想，才来留学的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_335
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我只是凭着莫名的自信和冲动就来留学了，
感觉和大家格格不入

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_336
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
到头来，别说是成为学校的中心了，我连朋友都没有。
所以我才回到了日本

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_337
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
刚才遇见的是我初中的朋友。
我穿着校服，所以被她们发现我留学失败了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_338
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我明明不想让她们知道现在的自己是什么模样的。
啊啊，我已经完了~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_340
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶，等等……你要去哪里？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_341
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
水族馆的宣传单？
上面用笔写了些什么……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_342
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『逃避也没关系』『迷路的孩子』……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_343
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这是小灯写的吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_344
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 迷路的孩子……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_345
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 还没有结束……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_347
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哈哈，迷路的孩子啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_348
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那么~要一起前进吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_349
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我们这两个迷路的孩子，一起前进

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_350
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……怎么样！？刚才的演奏！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_351
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
因为之前说了『要举办演出』嘛。
至少要弹到这种水平吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_352
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯，加油……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_353
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……说起来，
快速轻松升级……
不对，我之前有拜托你作曲呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_354
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我也很想看！让我看看让我看看~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_355
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶嘿嘿，是吗？
如果是这样，那新歌一写完我是不是就能弹了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_356
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
真的？从你开始作曲
才过了三天吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_357
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 真的已经是一首完整的曲子了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_358
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……嗯？是说曲子好的意思吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_359
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 唔……她的吉他技术果然很强……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_360
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但、但是，没有她的部分吧？
Rikki也是刚作完曲……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_361
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢谢你等我
做完值日！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_362
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
每天都有练习，还挺辛苦的呢~
我的手指都伤痕累累了~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_363
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，我有用你给我的创可贴哦！
企鹅的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_364
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶~它叫这个名字啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_365
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……今天小乐奈会来练习吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_366
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
明明都把小乐奈的部分加进去，重新作了曲的。
之前还觉得她怎么突然跑过来加入练习，现在又说都不说一声就不来了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_367
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
所以，Rikki一直都很烦躁的样子。
虽然她对我严厉已经是家常便饭了，但对待爽世同学，她态度也很强硬

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_368
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不如说，问题在曲子上！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_369
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
因为不知道小乐奈会不会来……
所以有她和没她的两种版本的乐谱
我都要练习！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_370
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
到底哪个是哪个，
我都已经搞不清楚了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_371
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？爽世同学？
你怎么在羽丘？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_372
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ？你说什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_373
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
原来是在等我们呀~！
那就一起去练习吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_374
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 辛苦了~Rikki，你已经到了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_375
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那个~
今天要按哪个乐谱练习呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_376
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……
那个我还不会弹呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_378
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……弹错了……
要更加用力按住琴弦才行……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_379
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，又失败了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_380
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……不要大声凶我啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_381
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
每次练习，都要弹不同版本的曲子。
我已经很努力了，但你只知道怪我

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_382
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你也多为别人考虑考虑啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_383
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我也是……
刚才就一直在给她发消息……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_384
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……我可能也说得有点过了。
我们确实把很多事情都交给了她处理……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_385
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
在Rikki出现之前，
我们等了2小时56分31秒~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_386
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
她跑了！！
小灯，我们追！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_388
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那就站住！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_389
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
没事！
就算被发现了也是写检讨，反正我很会写作文！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_390
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
吵死了！
只要你站住不就全都解决了吗！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_391
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯，就这样把路堵住！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_394
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还不是因为你不肯停下来嘛！
呜呜，膝盖擦伤得好严重~~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_395
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那是……创可贴？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_396
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……噗，啊哈哈！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_397
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 谁叫她这么可爱嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_398
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
Rikki，明天就是演出了哦。
怎么办。已经逃不掉了哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_399
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我呢？我呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_400
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哇？猫……？
从哪里冒出来的……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_401
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呃……
总之，小乐奈也找到了呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_402
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 呜呜~马上就要正式演出了啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_403
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我已经不行了……
其他乐队都太厉害了，
彩排的时候还有一边弹吉他一边唱歌的人……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_404
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唔……我会练习，
但你也不必用这种语气讲话吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_405
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，什么什么？
Rikki在紧张吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_406
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不得了，气氛真是超级热烈……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_407
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哈——我们真的能……
演出成功吗……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_408
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
就是说啊~！
彩排的时候就很紧张了，
观众来了之后，更是不知道该怎么办才好~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_409
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，你们两个……
呜~~那就上吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_411
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊！好、好了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_412
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对、对不起！搞错了！
再来一次……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_414
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 唔唔……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_415
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我知道，但是太紧张了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_416
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢谢……
哈——好像稍微冷静一点了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_417
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小舞她们来了啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_418
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对不起！已经没事了！
来演奏吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_419
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 谢谢大家！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_420
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （诶？春日影？要演奏吗？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_421
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: （话说，看这个情况是要演奏吧……？）

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_422
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哎！演出是不是非常成功！？
非常成功对吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_423
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小灯也是！
唱得棒极了~！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_424
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 她来了啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_425
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊……爽世同学！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_426
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，小乐奈在这里！
抱歉让你久等了——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_427
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
Rikki也说马上就到了！
……爽世同学呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_428
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这样啊……
那次演出之后，她就没联系过我们，没问题吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_429
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
没、没事的！
爽世同学很温柔，肯定会原谅我们的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_430
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不过，总之要和她谈谈才行呢。
Rikki应该能联系到她吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_431
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等、等一下啊。
爽世同学还没来呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_432
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这是演出后第一次练习，
如果我们擅自开始，爽世同学可能会不高兴的。
还是等大家都到齐了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_433
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不是这个意思啦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_434
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你看——！
小灯也这么觉得！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_435
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？你到底站哪边的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_436
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶……她回去了……
不是她喊我们来的吗……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_438
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 没办法嘛

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_439
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学完全联系不上，
连小乐奈都不来了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_440
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 去是去了，但没能见到她

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_441
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 唉~~~怎么办……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_442
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你又这么说！
倒是稍微担心一下啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_443
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……凛凛子小姐
或许能联系上小乐奈

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_444
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我去一下！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_445
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，为什么？
新成员是怎么回事？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_446
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 等等，爽世同学呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_447
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
什么叫不行……我完全听不懂你的意思啊？
她是没来练习，
但也可能真的是身体不舒服……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_448
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶，你见到爽世同学了？
倒是喊我们一下呀！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_449
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 等一下啊……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_451
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那、那个，我是千早爱音。
这位是小灯……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_452
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好好解释一下。
假的是怎么回事？爽世同学说了要退出乐队吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_453
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
什么啊，那Rikki就是擅自带新人来了？
太奇怪了吧？应该好好和爽世同学——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_455
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我回去了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_456
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不是不需要我吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_457
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 小灯就和爽世同学继续组CRYCHIC吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_458
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 早~小舞

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_459
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……啊，小香奈、小绘梨，早——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_461
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……？什么事？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_462
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……不是不需要我吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_463
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不要突然发出这么大声音啊！
吓我一跳

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_465
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……为什么要追过来？
你们已经有吉他手了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_466
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我又不是真的想玩乐队……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_467
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……无所谓吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_469
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是因为虚荣心啦！
我只是想让大家觉得我很厉害而已！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_471
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……啊啊~
都是小灯的错哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_472
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 爽世同学，等等。我有话要说

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_473
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 爽世同学！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_474
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我会一直跟着你，直到你肯听我说话为止！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_475
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学……呃！
这公寓是怎么回事……！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_476
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶~好厉害……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_477
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶~~~？
天花板好高！沙发好大！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_478
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
也太像豪华酒店了，生活感为零啊……
你该不会是一个人住吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_479
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢、谢谢。
这个香气……是初次见面的时候我们一起喝的茶呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_480
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
听说了哦。虽然很生气，
但却让我觉得，爽世同学也是人类呢~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_481
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不仅是个两面派，谎话一个接一个，
还有着坏心眼的地方

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_482
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……你是个迷路的孩子

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_483
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是小灯说的哦。
小爽世和我，都是迷路的孩子

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_484
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小灯在等你。
就算你说不需要我，
我还是会在乐队里

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_485
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
是啊。
这不是我们组建的乐队嘛

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_486
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哇……
好多观众啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_488
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊~好了好了。我这就连扩音器

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_489
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……谢谢大家！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_490
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 什么情况！？我完全不明白……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_491
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，你们在啊！
Rikki、小乐奈，你们来得真早呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_492
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
和我一起来的。她现在在前台，
爽世同学呢？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_493
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这样啊……
我想她应该看见消息了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_494
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？怎么突然说这个

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_495
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……
有兴致的时候会稍微弹一弹~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_496
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哈啊！？这是……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_497
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……你太不会道歉了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_498
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但这样距离正式演出几乎没有准备时间哦？
怎么办？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_499
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我们的歌，
只有Rikki写的『碧天伴走』这一首吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_500
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这样的话，其他能演奏的歌……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_501
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……等一下！
你们是不是忘记了更重要的事情！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_502
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
乐队名和演出服！！
还什么都没定呢！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_503
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这次我绝对不会让步的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_504
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我来做演出服！
今晚就想设计图！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_505
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……现在才发现？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_506
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 她应该没想过吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_507
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
如果不顽固的话，她也不至于宁愿和我们吵架，
也要找回爽世同学了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_508
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
她没有放弃乐队，也没有放弃爽世同学。
即使只剩下她自己

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_509
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我们真是被小灯牵着鼻子走呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_510
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那个。
我不打算喊你爽世同学了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_511
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我不会退出！
所以Soyorin也不要退出哦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_512
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不要退出哦——！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_513
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
但是，乐队名已经想好了呀！
『ANON TOKYO』！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_514
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
为什么！？怎么想都只有这一个选项吧！
真是没品位！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_515
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 当然，我有认真思考哦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_516
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我把演出服的参考图传到手机里了~
看，这种怎么样？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_517
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 被固有观念框住可不好哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_518
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我觉得有各种各样的展示方法是好事！
我还是想引人注目！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_519
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好啦好啦，坐吧。
这边沙发的视野也很好哦~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_520
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 如果有什么不懂的，都可以问我哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_521
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
？好吃……？
诶？小乐奈，你在吃什么！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_522
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 现在就已经在吃饭了吗！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_523
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哦哦~刚才的声音是不是很棒！？
这个效果器好像买对了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_524
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
刚才我在乐器店看见的。
一下子就有来电的感觉了~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_525
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……咦？
怎么感觉拨片的形状……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_526
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶诶，怎么办……
早知道就买备用的拨片了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_527
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这是小乐奈的拨片……？
你要借给我用吗？谢谢~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_528
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，印着什么标识。
我看看……『SPACE』？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_530
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好过分，我们只是在练习嘛！
那我来处理演出服，Rikki和Soyorin也来帮忙吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_531
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？不是很可爱吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_532
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
明明是你们没品位！
对吧，Tomorin？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_533
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 是Rikki，Rikki啦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_534
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……话说，你们看外面！
夜景好漂亮！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_535
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对了！大家一起拍照吧！
我创建了一个乐队专用的社交媒体账号，把照片发在上面！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_536
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好啦好啦！
快点站好！Soyorin也快来！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_537
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我看看……糟糕，这什么啊？
只有我一个人拍得像模像样啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_538
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶？等一下，你们两个！
不重拍吗！？等等呀！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_539
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，Tomorin，你在这里啊。
今天在我家集合哦。走吧~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_541
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶诶？
之前去见她的时候，她不是当我们不存在吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_542
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: Tomorin……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_543
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: Tomorin……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_544
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……距离和Soyorin她们集合，
还有一段时间吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_545
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你看啊，Tomorin。
有好多企鹅在游泳哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_546
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 虽然是在水里，但看起来就像是飞在空中一样呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_547
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还以为来到这里或许会让你打起精神，
看来在那件事之后好像有点难呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_548
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……这个，给Tomorin

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_549
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 之前你给了我很多，所以也送给你

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_550
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我的心上就贴着哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_551
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
初中同学发现我的时候。
Tomorin就是在这里安慰我的吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_552
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还有，在天台上的时候……
你说，一起迷路吧……那句话也戳中了我

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_553
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……还有

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_554
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等——！
我马上要说一句很棒的话，你听着！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_555
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那个。
一辈子组乐队的事情

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_556
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我也会努力试试的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_557
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
虽然一辈子很遥远，
但把许许多多的一瞬间叠加起来，或许就也没那么遥远

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_558
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
说实话，我没有自信，也可能会大吐苦水……
但只要在迷茫中前进就可以了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_559
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……所以，演出一起加油吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_560
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……噗，啊哈哈！
Tomorin真可爱

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_561
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等、等一下！
难道你是sumimi的初华——！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_562
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……啊！不好意思！
你现在是在休假吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_563
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶~！好温柔~！
我非常喜欢sumimi，是小初华的粉丝……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_564
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
诶！我之前跟你说过吧！
就是我们第一次一起去卡拉OK的时候！
那个双人组合……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_565
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……？你们俩以前就认识吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_566
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，对了！
我们在玩乐队，
如果可以的话，请关注一下我们的账号……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_567
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
什么，这是梦吗……？
话说，既然你和小初华认识，倒是告诉我呀~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_568
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——但是，你之前不知道小初华的事情呢。
那就没办法了啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_569
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯？但是小初华……
知道Tomorin的名字吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_570
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶？那，为什么……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_571
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 所以，帮我做演出服吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_572
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
话说，我一个人做五个人的演出服太难了吧？
你们要帮帮我啊~

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_573
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
基础服装已经送到了，
接下来只需要添加一些布料进行再加工！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_574
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不好！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_575
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊——Tomorin写完歌词很累，
还是让她睡一会比较好吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_576
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 现在Rikki正在根据歌词完善曲子

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_577
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
她说会在今天内完成，把曲子带过来，
等Rikki来了再把Tomorin叫醒吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_578
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不好吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_579
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，Rikki你总算来了。
曲子写好了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_580
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那么，Rikki就做自己的演出服吧。
这是布料和线……还有什么来着？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_581
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
Soyorin可能不想起来。
她说她是不熬夜主义……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_582
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小乐奈，衣服做得怎么样了……啊！
等等！为什么要打开吉他盒！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_583
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，Tomorin醒了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_584
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……吉他用了多久才会变成这样？
到处都破破烂烂的……是古董吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_585
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
奶奶……
说起来，你给我拨片的时候也说了呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_586
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 米拉……什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_587
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……哪怕跌倒，哪怕迷茫，也要一辈子吗

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_588
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊……！
对呀，Tomorin！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_589
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等一下！
我有好好保存着……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_590
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 找到了，就是这个！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_591
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
和Tomorin第一次去水族馆时的宣传单！
你还记得当时写了什么吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_592
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 没错！我们的乐队名！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_593
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『迷路的孩子的乐队』！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_594
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
新歌我们只合奏过一次啊！
我说~按那种感觉就行了吗！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_595
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我说，那个算是完成了吧？
刚才那个，算是完成新曲了吧~！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_596
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那个，我们是『迷路的孩子的乐队』！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_597
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，不是迷路的孩子，
是迷路的孩子的乐队……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_598
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哈啊……
居然直接说迷路的孩子……已经被省略了……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_599
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: Rikki不是也说『迷路的孩子的乐队』很好嘛！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_600
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你说了~
因为我们的乐队，总是在迷路……诶！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_601
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
总是在迷路……
总是迷路？It's……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_602
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……！
It's my go！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_603
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
It's my go呀！
It's my go！不得了，重大发现！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_604
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
对，没错！
不是非常棒吗！？
非常符合我们！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_605
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哼哼。
看吧？把演出服做出来是正确的吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_606
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶，什、什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_607
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
等等，怎么了怎么了？
你想说什么呀~！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_608
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，等等，小乐奈

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_609
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: Tomorin，不说点什么吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_610
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不是说这个啦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_611
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我是爱音！没有那么容易迷路啦。
地图也能看懂的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_612
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
呵呵……那么，接下来。
Tomorin也自我介绍一下吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_613
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 唔唔~结束了~！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_614
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
Tomorin，你说了『MyGO』，
那个难道是，难道是！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_615
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哈！？
开始之前，你不是还在质疑这是什么名字吗！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_616
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
既然这样，我想到了一个更好的！
在MyGO后面加上五个『！』……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_618
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
很不错吧！？
我觉得这样更有前进的感觉！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_619
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 诶——！这个绝对很棒的——！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_620
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
小乐奈！？
哇——别在这里睡啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_621
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊啊~真是的！
行了，把小乐奈带去休息室吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 嗯~~！面试结束了~！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （我在初中的时候担任过学生会会长，成绩品行也不差）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（虽然转学的时间很奇怪，
但入学应该没问题吧）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （私立羽丘女子学园，高中部……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_10

ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

不过还是希望能和大家好好相处。
请大家多多关照！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_17

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_18

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 啊、啊哈哈哈，请多关照啦——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_21

ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

和你们一起吃便当吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
真的吗？太好了~
我还在想，要是找不到一起吃饭的人

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……叫我爱音就好！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_30
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

大家都已经有自己的小圈子了吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_31
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不不！
前几天她在捡石头？的时候，我正好碰见了她……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_32
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
嗯？哇！这是什么！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_33
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_34
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_35

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_36
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_37
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_39
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_40
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_41

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_42
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_45
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_47
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_48
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_49
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_50
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_51
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_52
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你钢琴弹得真好啊……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_53
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_54
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_55
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_56
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

我正在寻找乐队成员，我是吉他手兼主唱……
想说你愿不愿意来当键盘手——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_57
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_58
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 有没有愿意和我组乐队的人呢……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_59
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 嗯？那边的是……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_60
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （我记得她也没有组乐队吧？）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_61
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
喂——！那个，我记得是叫……
高松同学——呀啊！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_62
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

绊了一跤……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_63
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_64
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

等、等等……你要去哪里！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_65
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

怎么了？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_66
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_67
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_68
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 诶？帽带？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_69
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 高、高松同学也喜欢企鹅吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_70
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

我也会觉得笔很可爱，然后买了一堆用不到的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_71
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 等、等下等下，不用拿这么多

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_72
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

不要一下子就失落啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_73
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_74
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

好像是叫……Roselia？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_75
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你说的笔记本，是指这本活动日志吗？
我看看……今天看了星星。星空好噜♪啊……
噜是什么……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_76
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……天文社好像很容易吸引神奇的人，
或者说是有个性的人呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_77
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 诶？啊~~嗯，我会考虑的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_78
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
真是的——又开始失落了——
不要动不动就失落嘛……嗯？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_79
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这本笔记本是高松同学的吗？
原来高松同学也写日志啊，我能看看吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_80
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 高松同学这不是有在玩乐队嘛！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_81
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这里写的是歌词吧？
也写着和弦呢……啊！
还贴着乐队乐谱的复印件！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_82
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶——这首歌叫『春日影』啊。
我没听过呢，是哪一支乐队的歌？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_83
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
真的吗？那要和我组乐队吗？
我是吉他手兼主唱，
除此之外你担任什么都可以哦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_84
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（如果班级里的吉祥物加入，
肯定会引人注目的）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_85
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……啊，是吗——
抱歉抱歉。你不感兴趣的话没关系的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_86
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_87
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊——真是的——！不行！
这种阴沉的气氛，我真的不擅长啦——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_88
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不用道歉，快收拾一下！
我们去卡拉OK吧，小灯！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_89
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
心情不好的时候，最好的办法就是出去玩！
我陪你去，好了，走吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_90
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
从刚才开始你就一直在发呆，怎么了？
难道说你是第一次来卡拉OK？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_91
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
是吗。那你会唱sumimi的歌吗？
我唱初华的部分，你唱真奈的部分

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_92
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶，你不知道sumimi吗？
最近还挺火的啊……
是双人组合，很可爱~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_93
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊——你不知道啊……
那还是唱你喜欢的歌吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_94
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不擅长也没关系哦！
难得我们一起来，只有我一个人唱多不好啊？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_95
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
唔……那么，刚才那首叫什么来着？
『春日影』……唔——搜不出来呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_96
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶，是原创歌曲吗……？
难道说，小灯的乐队是挺专业的那种……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_97
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那个……你说会再次失败，是指什么？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_98
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
就算组乐队也会再次失败，是为什么？
你以前的乐队经常发生争执吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_99
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊……难道是那个吗？
音乐理念的差异！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_100
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……是吗。
那你一定很难受吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_101
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……不过，只要努力不再失败，不就好了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_102
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
就算失败一次，也要有重新再来的勇气啊——
否则，人生那么长，肯定会很难熬哦？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_103
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这次说不定能奇迹般地
遇到非常棒的成员呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_104
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊——那个人倒不一定是我。
不过，我还是希望你能来组乐队嘛~♪
毕竟小灯有经验

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_105
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……诶？一辈子？
啊……啊哈哈，小灯真会说笑呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_106
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊！小灯！？
你要去哪里！？等一下……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_107
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小灯！等等！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_108
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
哈啊、哈啊……
抱歉，突然笑你……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_109
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_110
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
什、什么……
这个人是谁？是小灯认识的人吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_111
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶，啊！小灯！？
又逃跑了……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_112
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 都说了，我是小灯的朋友——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_113
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
她逃跑了，我才追她的！
我只是邀请她组乐队而已

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_114
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
是啊？
我说啊，不要总是你这家伙你这家伙的——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_115
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
！？哈啊！？
胡搅蛮缠的明明是你吧！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_116
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
等等！……那家伙怎么回事啊！！
也太没礼貌了吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_117
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 怎么可能没事……呃，诶？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_118
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊，唔……没、没事~
什么事都没有，别担心~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_119
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （唔——怒吼的样子被人看见，好尴尬啊……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_120
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 早~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_121
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （唔，小灯很低落……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_122
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（从昨天的情况来看，也不是没有道理……
小灯的乐队，好像发生了很多事情）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_123
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（一辈子……这种事，我还是不太明白……
但越想越不是滋味……好）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_124
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……早~小灯

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_125
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊，你又在看企鹅创可贴吗？
这是什么种类的企鹅来着？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_126
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
对对，是帽带企鹅！
你在活动室给我的创可贴上也有它呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_127
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那我就收下啦。谢谢~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_128
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （唔……看这个感觉，应该没问题吧~）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_129
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （这么说来，她们好像是说过这件事……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_130
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 啊~还没有呢~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_131
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （其实我也没那么认真啦……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_132
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （不过，这种话也说不出口啊……唉……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_133
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
谢谢你们三个~！
那既然有这个机会，就拜托啦——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_134
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（我就觉得好像在哪里见过
RiNG这个名字……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_135
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（昨天被那个怪人纠缠的地方
就是RiNG的门口嘛）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_136
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（难道说，那家伙是这里的工作人员？
呃，要是再碰到就太糟糕了）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_137
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（小舞她们已经去录音棚练习了，
看完公告板上的招募信息我就走人吧）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_138
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
唔，公告板公告板……
招募鼓手，招募键盘手和贝斯手……嗯？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_139
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 啊！是昨天那个月之森的人！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_140
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （提到月之森，那可是名门中的名门贵族女校……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_141
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
（听说只有政治家和艺人的孩子才能入学，
如果能和她交朋友，说不定会有好事发生……！）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_142
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
谢谢你担心我，跟我搭话。
而我连句谢谢都没说就走了，真是抱歉

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_143
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_145
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

说了你朋友的坏话，对不起……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_146
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_147
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这、这样啊……
话说，这边的咖啡厅真厉害呢。
甚至还有能演奏的舞台

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_148
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_149
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那个，可以问一下你的名字吗？
我叫爱音！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_150
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
哦哦……是的，
但完全没有适合我的位置……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_151
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶，社交平台……还有这种东西啊。
爽世同学，你很了解乐队相关的事呢！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_152
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶？月之森的人组乐队……？
有点惊讶……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_153
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
真好啊~！
我们高中的人，大家都在玩乐队呢~
但没有乐队有适合我的位置……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_154
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我是主唱和吉他手！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_155
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
实在不行的话，吉他的位置也可以让给别人……
不过，我还是想当主唱~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_156
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_157
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_158
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 真好~！我也要一样的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_159
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 她啧了一声！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 什么啊……！态度好差~！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_161
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

我和朋友说着话，她就突然冒出来了，

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_162
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_164
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_165
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_170
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_171

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_190

CRYCHIC的事情

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_195
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_196
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_197
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你们这么长时间都没有说过话啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小祥？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_199

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_200
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_201
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_202

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_206
