你好像没什么精神……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_286
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ？是很难说出口的话？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_287
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶……！？
为什么……不对……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_288
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你是……认真的？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_289
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你们想呀，我们没有乐队名，也没有演出服吧？
就这样演出的话应该不合适吧~
小灯也是这么说的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_290
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我刚才不是说了嘛！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_291
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 所以说，小灯她——！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_292
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶……结束……
是指像以前的乐队一样……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_293
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 好了，你想说什么……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_294
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不……
小灯不是说了不想演出嘛！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_295
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
而且，就算要演出，这次是不是也太赶了？
还是做好准备，在万无一失的状态下举办演出吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_296
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这样的话，小灯肯定也能
更好地……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_297
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_298
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我……都说了——！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_299
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_300
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 什么……我才没有逃避

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_301
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我、我当然有练习！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_302
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ！！我没有逃避！！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_303
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 哈啊、哈啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_304
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
嘴上说着没有逃避，但现在明明就在尽全力逃跑……
我果然还是在逃避吗……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_305
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_306
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不会吧，为什么……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_307
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_308
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_309
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: （等等。别再问我了……）

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_310
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_311
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那个，这个是……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_312
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小、小灯……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_313
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶……！？
等等，小灯……！？
你要带我去哪里……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_314
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 为什么要来水族馆……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_315
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_316
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……难道说，
你是想安慰我？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_317
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你记得啊……
它们是什么企鹅来着。
你给我的创可贴里有吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_318
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……噗，这样啊……
说起来你好像是给过我……呵呵

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_319
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
哈啊~谢、
谢谢……多亏了你，我心情好点了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_320
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……刚才，
Rikki在咖啡厅里说的话……
其实是对的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_321
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
就是说我在逃避的那个。
我转学的时间不是很奇怪吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_322
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
自我介绍的时候我说是因为家里的原因……
但真正的原因是，我之前去海外留学了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_323
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
但是，我完全跟不上那边的节奏，
然后就逃走了……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_324
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我初中的时候很开心

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_325
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
每个学校里都会有个引人注目的、受欢迎的人吧？
在我们初中，我就是那样的人

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_326
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这种话自己说可能不太合适，
我当时成绩好，又是学生会会长，
交友的圈子也是学校里最闪闪发光的一群人

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_327
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我在文化节上参加乐队表演时，气氛很热烈，
学妹们都用崇拜的目光看着我

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_328
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我觉得，
自己就是这所学校的中心

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_329
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
可是，正因为太顺利了，
我才没有看清自己

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_330
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
因为英语好，我就一时兴起想去留学，
离开日本才发现，
留学生活和我想象中完全不同

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_331
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我本来以为，在英国也能像初中时那样，
成为学校的中心……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_332
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我本来以为自己很擅长的。
可却连自己想说的一半都表达不出来……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_333
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
而且，其他留学生都很有主见。
我连他们说的一半都听不懂，只能边听边笑

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_334
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
还有，大家都很优秀。
都是有自己的理想，才来留学的……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_335
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我只是凭着莫名的自信和冲动就来留学了，
感觉和大家格格不入

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_336
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
到头来，别说是成为学校的中心了，我连朋友都没有。
所以我才回到了日本

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_337
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
刚才遇见的是我初中的朋友。
我穿着校服，所以被她们发现我留学失败了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_338
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我明明不想让她们知道现在的自己是什么模样的。
啊啊，我已经完了~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_339
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_340
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 诶，等等……你要去哪里？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_341
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
水族馆的宣传单？
上面用笔写了些什么……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_342
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 『逃避也没关系』『迷路的孩子』……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_343
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这是小灯写的吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_344
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 迷路的孩子……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_345
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 还没有结束……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_346
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_347
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 哈哈，迷路的孩子啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_348
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那么~要一起前进吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_349
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我们这两个迷路的孩子，一起前进

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_350
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……怎么样！？刚才的演奏！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_351
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
因为之前说了『要举办演出』嘛。
至少要弹到这种水平吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_352
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 嗯，加油……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_353
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊……说起来，
快速轻松升级……
不对，我之前有拜托你作曲呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_354
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我也很想看！让我看看让我看看~！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_355
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶嘿嘿，是吗？
如果是这样，那新歌一写完我是不是就能弹了？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_356
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
真的？从你开始作曲
才过了三天吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_357
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 真的已经是一首完整的曲子了！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_358
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……嗯？是说曲子好的意思吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_359
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 唔……她的吉他技术果然很强……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_360
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
但、但是，没有她的部分吧？
Rikki也是刚作完曲……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_361
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
谢谢你等我
做完值日！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_362
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
每天都有练习，还挺辛苦的呢~
我的手指都伤痕累累了~

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_363
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊，我有用你给我的创可贴哦！
企鹅的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_364
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 诶~它叫这个名字啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_365
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……今天小乐奈会来练习吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_366
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
明明都把小乐奈的部分加进去，重新作了曲的。
之前还觉得她怎么突然跑过来加入练习，现在又说都不说一声就不来了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_367
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
所以，Rikki一直都很烦躁的样子。
虽然她对我严厉已经是家常便饭了，但对待爽世同学，她态度也很强硬

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_368
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不如说，问题在曲子上！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_369
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
因为不知道小乐奈会不会来……
所以有她和没她的两种版本的乐谱
我都要练习！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_370
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
到底哪个是哪个，
我都已经搞不清楚了……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_371
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
诶？爽世同学？
你怎么在羽丘？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_372
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ？你说什么？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_373
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
原来是在等我们呀~！
那就一起去练习吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_374
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 辛苦了~Rikki，你已经到了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_375
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……那个~
今天要按哪个乐谱练习呢？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_376
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_377

ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_380
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……不要大声凶我啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_381
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
每次练习，都要弹不同版本的曲子。
我已经很努力了，但你只知道怪我

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_382
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你也多为别人考虑考虑啊！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_383
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_385
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

在Rikki出现之前，
我们等了2小时56分31秒~！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_386
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

小灯，我们追！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_387
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_388

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_389
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那是……创可贴？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_396
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

哈哈哈哈哈哈！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_397

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_398

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_408

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_409
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_410

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_413

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_414
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 唔唔……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_415
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我知道，但是太紧张了……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_416
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
谢谢……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_417
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 小舞她们来了啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_418

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_419

ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 谢谢大家！！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_420

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_421

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_422

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_423
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_424
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 她来了啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_425
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 啊……爽世同学！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_426
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_427
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

……爽世同学呢？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_428
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_429
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_anon ws_voice_finished_11#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_430
